##### Project general facts

Marquise Square is a striking development, spanning twenty-nine floors, this impressive project boasts a range of immaculately finished studios and one, two, and three-bedroom apartments. Developed in partnership between SRG Properties and Seven Tides, Marquise Square offers high-quality build and turnkey investment solutions, providing guaranteed ROI and peace of mind in one of Dubai's most sought-after locations.

Residents enjoy a range of world-class amenities designed to elevate everyday living. A podium-level swimming pool with a children's pool offers refreshing escapes, while a state-of-the-art gymnasium and health club cater to fitness enthusiasts. A multifunctional outdoor court and children's play area provide spaces for recreation and family fun, while food and beverage outlets add convenience. A welcoming reception lobby with a bespoke concierge desk and 24-hour security service ensure peace of mind, with five passenger lifts and one service lift providing seamless access.

Every residence at Marquise Square features bespoke laminated European-made doors with luxurious matte black finishing throughout, bespoke fitted wardrobes in all bedrooms, and high-quality Italian tiles. Kitchens are bespoke designs incorporating an eclectic mix of materials, with composite stone worktops, high-end quartz splashbacks, fully integrated top-of-the-range SIEMENS appliances, feature lighting, and STOSA Italian-made cabinets and wall units. European-made LED lighting, LEGRAND light switches and power sockets, and Cat 6 wiring with television, telephone, and data points complete the exceptional specification. 

##### Location description and benefits

Nestled on Burj Khalifa Street within the world-famous Burj Khalifa District, this exceptional location places residents at the heart of the city's future. The remarkable location is just minutes from the world's tallest building and key business and financial districts, including the Middle East's premier business hub, the Dubai International Financial Centre (DIFC).

The location is distinguished by its proximity to iconic landmarks and essential amenities. Dubai Mall, metro stations, Burj Khalifa, and DIFC are all within easy reach, making Marquise Square a compelling investment opportunity in one of Dubai's most sought-after spots. The area's strategic positioning offers residents unparalleled access to world-class shopping, dining, entertainment, and business destinations.

For those seeking a residence that embodies superior quality, strategic connectivity, and a prime Dubai address, the Burj Khalifa District delivers an unmatched lifestyle. Its unique combination of iconic landmarks, world-class amenities, and a prestigious location makes it one of Dubai's most desirable destinations. This is a place where one can enjoy the best of city living.
